notes: Design-approval resolutions of the Art Commission, 1962-1966. From 1962 the minutes print each resolution with a number, a title and the meeting date, and name the architect in the body; the 1964-66 approvals go by Phase 1 (schematic), Phase 2 and Phase 3 (final drawings). 488 resolutions split out of the five volumes; 26 curated here, 21 onto pages and 5 held for a page.

coverage.remaining: 1960 and 1961 (Internet Archive identifiers not found), 1967-1983 (the approval wording changes and the 1962 resolution splitter does not match it). Within 1962-1966: the airport, Hetch Hetchy, Log Cabin Ranch and Sunol items (outside the city), encroachments, marquees and signs on private buildings were skipped; not placed: Buena Vista School (Starr King Annex, Project 222), Potrero Hill Junior High (Project 210), Diamond Heights High (Project 205), Louise M. Lombard School, Hamilton Square Annex fieldhouse, Garfield Square fieldhouse, Mission Nursery, the Fire Department headquarters, Cowell Hall at the Academy of Sciences (since replaced).
coverage.note: Resolution splitter in /mnt/project-files/sf-art-commission/ (res6.py); the curated list is F2.py.
